title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin defies extreme fear, climbing 3.4% to $64,638 as sentiment sits at 25. Overnight gains held through the Asia session with steady buying pressure despite the caution.

Hashrate remains robust at 1,019 EH/s while the mempool shows 97,273 transactions and minimal fees at 2 sat/vB. Block height has reached 958,138.

Watch for follow-through momentum today. Low fees could support on-chain activity if price sustains above $64,000.
